title: A first-quadrant resolution-column augmentation induces a total quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K a first-quadrant double complex [def-sp-double-complex-total], A a nonnegative cochain complex, and a:A→K.X 0 a chain map satisfying a≫K.d 0 1=0. Let b:A→Tot(K) be a chain map whose degree-n component is a.f n followed by the (0,n) total inclusion. Assume for every n that the map from A.X n concentrated in resolution degree zero to the resolution column K.flip.X n, with degree-zero component a.f n, is a quasi-isomorphism (meaning an isomorphism on every homology object). Then b is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4, variant involving the second variable

proof.text: Form the augmented bicomplex whose resolution columns are the mapping cones of the specified column augmentations, with resolution degree shifted by one. Its total identifies, up to the usual shift and total signs, with the cone of b because hb specifies all augmentation components. Extend by zero and transpose to use the resolution direction as inner homology. Every such column is acyclic by the column quasi-isomorphism hypothesis.

Apply the first-quadrant spectral sequence [thm-sp-double-complex-spectral-sequences]. All column homology objects vanish, so its second page and subsequent pages vanish. Each total degree has a finite diagonal filtration; the associated graded pieces of cone homology are all zero, and induction on the filtration makes cone homology zero. Thus b is a quasi-isomorphism. This is also a finite diagonal chase: exactness removes components successively in increasing Cech degree, while the resolution degree decreases until the bound is reached.

lean.statement: theorem quasiIso_of_column_augmentation {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) (A : CochainComplex C ℕ) (a : A ⟶ K.X 0) (ha : a ≫ K.d 0 1 = 0) (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) (hb : ∀ n : ℕ, b.f n = a.f n ≫ K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp)) (hcol : ∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso ((CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv (K.flip.X n) (A.X n)).symm ⟨a.f n, by simpa using congrArg (fun f ↦ f.f n) ha⟩)) : QuasiIso b
